name: earnings_call
hook: I put a live spin meter on this earnings call.

questions.label: Specific number
questions.instructions: Does this sentence state a specific figure (revenue, margin, growth rate, guidance number)?

questions.label: Vague guidance
questions.instructions: Does this sentence talk about the future in vague terms without committing to anything measurable?

questions.label: Blames outside factors
questions.instructions: Does this sentence attribute weak results to outside factors (macro, weather, FX, supply chain) rather than the company?

questions.label: Hype language
questions.instructions: Does this sentence rely on promotional or hype language (incredible, transformational, unprecedented) rather than facts?

questions.label: Dodged question
questions.instructions: Given the analyst's question, does this sentence avoid answering what was actually asked?
